description:
🇸🇬 Singapore NEA Meteorological Bot

Track real-time Air Quality (1-Hour PM2.5, Official NEA Bands, Haze), 2-hour localized town nowcasts, 24-hour forecasts, 4-day outlook, and live UV index.

✨ Features:
• 🗺️ Interactive Singapore Map Dashboard
• 🚨 Proactive Elevated PM2.5 (Band 2+) and Heavy Rain Alerts
• 📍 Town-by-town weather across 47 districts
• ☀️ Real-time UV Index monitor

Tap /start to begin!
